subject: mattermost-mattermost-36824
note: STANDING sample — chosen once. Grade it blind (relabelled, mixed with live clusters) on every grading day that touches this subject, and record the result with judge_stability.py --calibration. Do not re-draw: a fresh draw confounds sampling with drift.

clusters.summary: The two new AppError i18n IDs (model.command_response.is_valid.response_type.app_error and .text.app_error) are missing from server/i18n/en.json, so the raw dotted key becomes the error Message in logs, developer-mode responses and Go client errors.

CommandResponseFromHTTPBody only validates the application/json branch; text/plain bodies go through CommandResponseFromPlainText which never calls IsValid, so the same oversized payload is rejected as JSON but accepted by switching Content-Type.

Validation lives in the shared bidirectional decoder CommandResponseFromJSON, which Client4.ExecuteCommand/ExecuteCommandWithTeam also use to decode server-emitted responses that are never validated server-side (plugin/built-in commands), so a response the webapp renders fine fails to decode in mmctl and every Go client; validation belongs at the ingest sites, not the decoder.

The new test cases assert only assert.Error/assert.Nil (with an ASCII payload that does not pin byte vs rune) and never check the AppError Id or StatusCode, so a case failing for an unrelated reason such as a JSON typo still passes.

IsValid recurses through all ExtraResponses and propagates any nested failure, so one bad extra entry (even at a depth no consumer ever reads) rejects the whole payload and discards the valid main message, contradicting HandleCommandResponse's per-entry tolerance.

The http.StatusBadRequest set on IsValid's AppErrors has no observable effect because both call sites wrap it in a fresh outer AppError, so the failure surfaces to the user as a generic 500 via app/command.go.
commandWebhook reads r.Body without a LimitReader, unlike the outgoing-command path capped at MaxIntegrationResponseSize (pre-existing).
The test literal "shliapa_type" used as an invalid response_type is inert test data, not a defect.

IsValid's nil-skip lets {"extra_responses":[null]} through as a nil element that HandleCommandResponse/HandleCommandResponsePost later dereference, a reachable nil-pointer panic from commandWebhook and custom slash commands.
IsValid is new exported public API with no direct unit test; it is exercised only transitively through CommandResponseFromJSON.
Missing blank line before the final `return nil` in IsValid, inconsistent with the spacing of the other blocks in the function.

The number of ExtraResponses entries is left unbounded even though the new validator walks them all, so a single body under the payload cap can demand thousands of post inserts and websocket broadcasts downstream.
Capture of the table-driven test case variable under t.Parallel() was examined and cleared, since the module's Go version gives per-iteration loop variables.
Attachment text is an unbounded alternate channel around the new Text limit — examined and cleared because attachments remain bounded downstream by PostPropsMaxRunes, so the change opens no new gap.
A parse failure in the delayed-response endpoint returns 400 before CommandWebhook.TryUse is called, so a retrying integration never consumes one of its five uses and can re-fail indefinitely.
